page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c56g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server type powered by the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 56 vCPUs derived from 28 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, built on the x86_64 architecture. Hardware instruction extensions include AVX-512 with VNNI, AES, and SHA-NI. System memory totals 346.0 GB, yielding 6.18 GB per vCPU. Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU equipped with 24 GB of VRAM. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 16 Gbps, and no local disk storage is bundled with the instance.

Benchmark results highlight strong AI inference capabilities facilitated by the NVIDIA A10 GPU. In LLM inference evaluations, prompt processing reached 9,738.91 tokens/sec on a small 135M model and 2,464.01 tokens/sec on a medium 7B model, while text generation achieved 457.19 and 89.85 tokens/sec respectively, placing all tested inference metrics in the top tier (top 10%). On general compute evaluations, the instance recorded a PassMark CPU score of 51,481.37, with strong results in CPU encryption (47,417.11), multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (262.06 GB/sec), and PassMark database operations (22,187.83). Standard stress-ng CPU execution and memory throughput benchmarks remained in the middle 50% category.

Cost efficiency is driven by the asymmetric allocation of a heavy compute and memory footprint paired with a single mid-range accelerator. Because local storage is absent, external network-attached volumes are required for persistent storage. The instance is suited for AI inference serving, graphics rendering, computer vision pipelines, multi-threaded batch data processing, and accelerated database operations.
